regions.name: Alakol
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Alakol, restored from its 2012 Encyclopedia map: the painting with the game’s roads, names and buttons on it. An image model took those markings off and sharpened it without moving anything, then it was toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The cleanest of the first four: cliffs, the rock ridge, the clouds, the beach and the huts sit where 2012 had them. The model returned it a little greener and more saturated; the toning step brings it back to 2012's colour.
